arxiv-2011-08198.title: MOSEL and IllustrisTNG: Massive Extended Galaxies at z = 2 z=2 Quench Later Than Normal-size Galaxies
arxiv-2011-08198.creator: Anshu Gupta, Kim-Vy Tran, Annalisa Pillepich, Tiantian Yuan, Anishya Harshan, Vicente Rodriguez-Gomez, Shy Genel
arxiv-2011-08198.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Anshu Gupta, Kim-Vy Tran, Annalisa Pillepich, Tiantian Yuan, Anishya Harshan, Vicente Rodriguez-Gomez, Shy Genel. Using the TNG100 (100 Mpc) 3 simulation of the IllustrisTNG project, we demonstrate a strong connection between the onset of star formation quenching and the stellar size of galaxies.

arxiv-2109-00277.title: Barium lines in high-quality spectra of two metal-poor giants in the Galactic halo Thanks: Based on observations made with the UVES at the ESO Very Large Telescope, Paranal Observatory, Chile (ID 098.B-0094(A); P.I. G. Cescutti).
arxiv-2109-00277.creator: G. Cescutti, C. Morossi, M. Franchini, P. Di Marcantonio, C. Chiappini, M. Steffen, M. Valentini, P. François, N. Christlieb, C. Cortés, C. Kobayashi & E. Depagne
arxiv-2109-00277.description: Abstract Context. Theoretical results showed the possibility that neutron capture elements were produced in the early Universe by two different sources: a frequent s − s- process source hosted by rotating massive stars, and a rare r − r- process source hosted most likely by neutron star mergers. The two sources produce barium with different isotopic compositions. Aims.

arxiv-2212-03442.title: Confinement of many-body Bethe strings
arxiv-2212-03442.creator: Jiahao Yang, Tao Xie, S. E. Nikitin, Jianda Wu, A. Podlesnyak
arxiv-2212-03442.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jiahao Yang, Tao Xie, S. E. Nikitin, Jianda Wu, A. Podlesnyak. Based on Bethe-ansatz approach and inelastic neutron scattering experiments, we reveal evolution of confinement of many-body Bethe strings in ordered regions of quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnet YbAlO 3 \rm YbAlO_{3} . In the antiferromagnetic phase, the spin dynamics is dominated by the confined length-1 Bethe strings, whose dominancy in the high-energy branch of the excitation spectrum yields to the confined length-2 Bethe strings when the material is tuned to the spin-density-wave phase.

arxiv-2302-07149.title: The oblique parameters in the 2HDM with Vector-Like Quarks: Confronting M W M_{W} CDF-II Anomaly
arxiv-2302-07149.description: Abstract The CDF collaboration has released a new measurement of the W W boson mass using their complete data set with 8.8 fb -1 in p ​ p ¯ p\bar{p} collisions. This result deviates from the Standard Model prediction by around 7 σ \sigma .

arxiv-2307-13462.title: The Subtle Effects of Mergers on Star Formation in Nearby Galaxies
arxiv-2307-13462.creator: Yang A. Li, Luis C. Ho, Jinyi Shangguan
arxiv-2307-13462.description: Abstract Interactions and mergers play an important role in regulating the physical properties of galaxies, such as their morphology, gas content, and star formation rate (SFR). Controversy exists as to the degree to which these events, even gas-rich major mergers, enhance star formation activity.

arxiv-2308-01000.title: MDT3D: Multi-Dataset Training for LiDAR 3D Object Detection Generalization
arxiv-2308-01000.creator: Louis Soum-Fontez, Jean-Emmanuel Deschaud, François Goulette
arxiv-2308-01000.description: Abstract Supervised 3D Object Detection models have been displaying increasingly better performance in single-domain cases where the training data comes from the same environment and sensor as the testing data. However, in real-world scenarios data from the target domain may not be available for finetuning or for domain adaptation methods.

arxiv-2405-04522.title: Astrometric Redshifts of Supernovae
arxiv-2405-04522.creator: Jaemyoung (Jason) Lee, Masao Sako, Richard Kessler, Alex I. Malz, The LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
arxiv-2405-04522.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jaemyoung (Jason) Lee, Masao Sako, Richard Kessler, Alex I. Malz, The LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration. Differential Chromatic Refraction (DCR) is caused by the wavelength dependence of our atmosphere’s refractive index, which shifts the apparent positions of stars and galaxies and distorts their shapes depending on their spectral energy distributions (SEDs).

arxiv-2406-17266.title: AG-LSEC: Audio Grounded Lexical Speaker Error Correction
arxiv-2406-17266.creator: Rohit Paturi, Xiang Li, Sundararajan Srinivasan
arxiv-2406-17266.description: Abstract Speaker Diarization (SD) systems are typically audio-based and operate independently of the ASR system in traditional speech transcription pipelines and can have speaker errors due to SD and/or ASR reconciliation, especially around speaker turns and regions of speech overlap.

arxiv-2507-02938.title: A Large Language Model-Empowered Agent for Reliable and Robust Structural Analysis
arxiv-2507-02938.creator: Jiachen Liu, Ziheng Geng, Ran Cao, Lu Cheng, Paolo Bocchini, Minghui Cheng
arxiv-2507-02938.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have exhibited remarkable capabilities across diverse open-domain tasks, yet their application in specialized domains such as civil engineering remains largely unexplored. This paper starts bridging this gap by evaluating and enhancing the reliability and robustness of LLMs in structural analysis of beams.

arxiv-2512-09573.title: Investigate the Low-level Visual Perception in Vision-Language based Image Quality Assessment
arxiv-2512-09573.creator: Yuan Li, Zitang Sun, Yen-Ju Chen, Shin’ya Nishida⁢
arxiv-2512-09573.description: Abstract Recent advances in Image Quality Assessment (IQA) have leveraged Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to generate descriptive explanations. However, despite their robust visual perception capabilities, these methods often struggle to reliably detect fundamental low-level visual distortions—such as blur, noise, or compression—and may yield inconsistent evaluations across repeated inferences.

arxiv-2602-02891.title: TraceNAS: Zero-shot LLM Pruning via Gradient Trace Correlation
arxiv-2602-02891.creator: Prajna G. Malettira, Manish Nagaraj, Arjun Roy, Shubham Negi, Kaushik Roy
arxiv-2602-02891.description: Abstract Structured pruning is essential for efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). The varying sensitivity of LLM sub-blocks to pruning necessitates the identification of optimal non-uniformly pruned models. Existing methods evaluate the importance of layers, attention heads, or weight channels in isolation. Such localized focus ignores the complex global structural dependencies that exist across the model.

pmc-10693477.title: Development of Multi-Vessel Coronary No-Reflow Following Elective Percutaneous Intervention in One Vessel
pmc-10693477.creator: Syed W Hussain, Eddison Ramsaran
pmc-10693477.description: Percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is a frequently performed procedure that can have minor or major complications. One of the more serious complications of PCI is the development of coronary no-reflow. No-reflow signifies reduced or absent coronary flow in the distal coronary circulation in the absence of flow-limiting lesions.

pmc-12564519.title: Perceived Quality-of-Life Importance Among Saudi Gynecologic Cancer Survivors: Latent Class Analysis
pmc-12564519.creator: Wedad M. Almutairi, Fatmah Alsharif, Ahlam Al-Zahrani, Noura Bin Afeef, Alkhnsa Alkeai, Haneen Alfakeeh, Arwa Alzahrani, Nouran Essam Katooa, Fathia Khamis Kassem, Wafa A. Faheem
pmc-12564519.description: Simple SummaryThis study looked at what matters most to women in Saudi Arabia who have survived gynecologic cancers such as breast or cervical cancer. The researchers asked 129 women to rate how important different aspects of life are to them after treatment—especially their emotional well-being, relationships, and sexual health. The women were grouped based on their answers.

pmc-13185357.title: Reduced thalamic glutathione in migraine: a MEGA-PRESS spectroscopy study
pmc-13185357.creator: Hongying Huang, Jiayin Miao, Yinji Piao, Zhaodong Lin, Yuqin Lin, Rui Wang, Zhongruowen Ren, Guangsong Wang, Dafa Shi, Gen Yan, Yongmin Chang, Renhua Wu
pmc-13185357.description: BackgroundMigraine and tension-type headache (TTH) are highly prevalent primary headache disorders lacking objective diagnostic biomarkers. Oxidative stress has been implicated in migraine pathophysiology, with glutathione (GSH) serving as the brain’s principal antioxidant. This study investigated whether thalamic GSH levels, measured using optimized MEGA-PRESS spectroscopy, could serve as a candidate biomarker for differentiating migraine from TTH.

pmc-13255748.title: The aging paradox of Cushing's syndrome: Stress without clear senescence?
pmc-13255748.creator: Israel Nunes Silveira, Alexandro Guterres
pmc-13255748.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cushing's syndrome (CS), characterized by chronic endogenous hypercortisolism and disruption of the normal circadian cortisol rhythm, represents a unique human model for investigating the interplay between stress endocrinology and biological aging. Glucocorticoid excess drives multiple convergent aging pathways: it suppresses telomerase activity and may accelerate telomere attrition, induces durable epigenetic remodeling, including hypomethylation of stress‐responsive genes such as FKBP5, TET‐mediated DNA hydroxymethylation changes, and broad dysregulation of circadian clock loci, and promotes telomere‐independent senescence through mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, and cytokine‐driven inflammation.

pmc-13265888.title: Congenital bulbourethral diverticulum with huge stones: a case report
pmc-13265888.creator: Guangjie Li, Zhiqiang He, Shulian Chen, Hengxin Yan
pmc-13265888.description: Male congenital urethral diverticulum with huge stones is an extremely rare benign disease. The patient was a 67-year-old male with a huge stone (4.5cm × 4.3cm × 4.1cm) in his bulbourethral diverticulum. The stones in the bulbourethral diverticulum have different treatment methods due to the different size of the stones.
